attribute_modifiers.description: Can be defined as a compound or a list.

modifiers.description: Contains Attribute Modifiers on this item which modify Attributes of the wearer or holder (if the item is not in the hand or armor slots, it has no effect).

show_in_tooltip.description: Show or hide attribute modifiers on this item's tooltip. Defaults to {{cd|true}}.

options.description: Contains Attribute Modifiers on this item which modify Attributes of the wearer or holder (if the item is not in the hand or armor slots, it has no effect).

type.description: The name of the attribute this modifier is to act upon.

name.description: The name of the Modifier. Has no known effect.

slot.description: Slot or slot type the item must be in for the modifier to take effect. Can be {{cd|d=or|any|hand|armor|mainhand|offhand|head|chest|legs|feet|body}}. Defaults to {{cd|any}}.

uuid.description: The modifier's UUID, stored as four ints. Used when equipping and unequipping the item to identify which modifier to add or remove from the entity.

amount.description: Amount of change from the modifier.

operation.description: Modifier operation. Can be {{cd|d=or|add_value|add_multiplied_base|add_multiplied_total}} See [ [Attribute#Modifiers|Attribute Modifiers] ] for info.
